items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: The Agabama was Barroso, Cheo Marqueti, the bongo player, the guitar player, the tres player and Chapotin in the trumpet.

ctx.x: Abelardo Barroso, the vocalist, he had a group called La Agabama?
Agabama, and Cheo Marqueti, a great singer too, was a bass player.
Cheo Marqueti played bass for La Agabama?
